svg.title: Hüseyin Emir Akay
svg.desc: Computer Engineering student at Atatürk University; vice captain and software developer of the ARES UAV team; builds ground control stations and operator interfaces. TEKNOFEST Fighting UAV finalist in 2025 (25th of 873) and 2026 (34th of 1053).
